extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly: SI2302S, FOSAN, n-channel MOSFET.
The supplied PDF states no revision identifier and contains three pages: maximum ratings and device marking on p. 1, tabulated electrical characteristics on p. 2, and package dimensions on p. 3.
No transfer, output, body-diode, or capacitance-versus-voltage plot is present in the supplied PDF; usable_curves is false and no curve points were generated.
The VGS(th) table provides MIN = 0.5 V and MAX = 1.5 V at ID = 250 uA and VGS = VDS; the TYP column is blank and is represented as null.

RDS(ON) rows are transcribed as inclusive maximum values: 65 mOhm at VGS = 4.5 V and ID = 3.6 A, and 80 mOhm at VGS = 2.5 V and ID = 2 A. The corresponding typical values are 55 mOhm and 65 mOhm. Both rows carry the printed pulse condition of pulse width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 2.0%.

On p. 2, the capacitance table labels the rows CISS and COSS and prints typical values CISS = 600 pF and COSS = 120 pF, with VGS = 0 V, VDS = 10 V, and f = 1 MHz. These direct PDF values convert to 6e-10 F and 1.2e-10 F respectively. The catalog hints Ciss = 120 pF and Coss = 30 pF are not used because they conflict with the labeled PDF table; no catalog cross-check fields are included.
CRSS is not published in the supplied electrical characteristics table and is represented as null.

BVDSS has MIN = 20 V and TYP = 22 V at ID = 250 uA and VGS = 0 V. The strict schema has one breakdown_voltage field, so the inclusive minimum value is used; the typical value remains noted here without being substituted.
Additional tabulated fields not represented by the strict schema include maximum ratings, IDSS, IGSS, turn-on time, and turn-off time; they are not mapped into unrelated schema fields.
omission_reason: The supplied three-page PDF contains no usable electrical characteristic plots. Pages 1 and 2 contain ratings and tabulated electrical characteristics only, and page 3 contains package dimensions.
